title: AutoSECO: Automated Skill Evolution for Cross-Problem Combinatorial Optimization with General-Purpose LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.30139v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: General-purpose large language model (LLM) agents can develop complete solvers for combinatorial optimization problems. Their specialization, however, often relies on workflows engineered for individual problems, limiting the reuse of development expertise. We propose AutoSECO, an automated skill evolution method that learns reusable solver-development guidance from experience. The challenge is that external evaluation measures the completed solver, while the skill guides decisions during development. AutoSECO connects this feedback to guidance deficiencies by tracing performance shortfalls through solver code and recorded development decisions. Revisions are expressed as general instructions and retained only if a fresh solver developed under the revised skill achieves a lower mean evaluation gap. Evolved solely on the traveling salesperson problem (TSP), the skill guides fresh agents in developing solvers for capacitated vehicle routin

translated_title: AutoSECO：基于通用大语言模型智能体的跨问题组合优化自动化技能进化
translated_abstract: 通用大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以为组合优化问题开发完整的求解器。然而，它们的专门化往往依赖于为单个问题精心设计的工作流程，这限制了开发专业经验的复用。我们提出AutoSECO，一种从经验中学习可复用求解器开发指导的自动化技能进化方法。其挑战在于：外部评估衡量的是已完成的求解器，而技能指导的是开发过程中的决策。AutoSECO通过在求解器代码和记录的开发决策中追踪性能缺陷，将外部反馈与指导上的不足联系起来。修订以通用指令的形式表达，并且只有在修订后技能指导下开发的新求解器取得更低的平均评估差距时才予以保留。仅在旅行商问题（TSP）上进化出的技能，便能够指导全新的智能体为带容量约束的车辆路径问题等开发求解器。
tldr: AutoSECO通过在求解器代码和开发决策中追踪性能缺陷来定位指导不足，使LLM智能体仅凭在TSP问题上的经验就能进化出可复用的开发技能，并将其迁移到其他组合优化问题的求解器开发中。
en_tdlr: AutoSECO enables general-purpose LLM agents to evolve reusable solver-development skills from experience by tracing performance shortfalls through solver code and recorded decisions, so that a skill evolved solely on TSP can guide agents to build solvers for other combinatorial optimization problems.
